Done. Summary of what happened:

1. **Identified the issue:** checkout-api on v2.3.1 was unhealthy with an ~18% error rate across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The most recent previously healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0:** The first rollback attempt partially failed (halted after us-east due to an orchestrator error), so I retried it and it completed successfully across all three regions.

3. **Verified recovery:** checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions, with the error rate down to ~0.2%.

4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** describing the failure, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the recovery. The on-call engineer has been paged.
